senses.gloss:
तृफ r. 6th cl. (तृफति)
 1. To content, to please.
 2. To be pleased or con-
tent.
 3. To hurt.
 E. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।

तृफला f. (-ला) The three myrobalans.
 E. तृ for त्रि three, फल a fruit,
fem. affix टाप्; also त्रिफला.

तृफू m. (-फूः) A serpent in general, the serpent genus.
 E. तृफ् to hurt,
or kill, ऊ Uṇādi aff.
